title: Auto-submit goal objective from goal command
description: When a user creates a goal with /goal <objective>, persist the goal first and then submit the objective as a user message so work starts immediately. Include unit tests and release/version updates.
close_reason: Implemented /goal objective auto-submit after persisted goal creation, with unit tests and release/version updates.

title: Fix goal status accounting and local extension conflicts
description: Goal status needs readable elapsed time, turn and continuation counts, token/cost breakdowns, and the project-local Pi extension must avoid collisions with the globally installed pi-goal package.
close_reason: Implemented detailed goal status accounting and local extension namespacing to avoid global package collisions.
